title.ru: Нужно и нельзя: must, have to, don't have to, mustn't
title.en: Obligation: must, have to, don't have to, mustn't
title.es: Obligación: must, have to, don't have to, mustn't

pattern.en: You don't have to pay — it's free.

text.ru: have to — обязанность из-за обстоятельств и правил (I have to get up early); must — сильнее, от говорящего или в инструкциях (You must see this film!). Главная ловушка: don't have to — «не обязательно», а mustn't — «нельзя». В прошлом и будущем — только have to: I had to wait, You'll have to pay.
text.en: have to = obligation from circumstances or rules; must = stronger, from the speaker or in instructions. Trap: don't have to = not necessary; mustn't = prohibited. Past and future use have to: I had to wait.
text.es: have to / must = obligación; don't have to = no es necesario; mustn't = prohibido.

rule.formula: must / have to + V — нужно · don't have to — не обязательно · mustn't — нельзя
